Devicon
=======

Language logos used as file icons by the monaco_multifile UI when the
vscode-icons set is turned off or has no icon for a file type. Only the
SVGs the UI uses are bundled; they are served locally so that no page
loads anything from a third-party CDN.

Source:  https://github.com/devicons/devicon (npm package devicon 2.17.0, `icons` folder)
License: MIT (see LICENSE in this directory)
